name: Movenpick Resort & Spa Boracay
short_description: A 312-room garden-set beachfront resort on Punta Bunga Cove, with a 3,300sqm multi-level pool -- the largest in Boracay -- and the Sagay Spa.
ai_summary: Movenpick Resort & Spa Boracay sits in tropical gardens on Punta Bunga Cove, on the northern tip of Boracay Island, about 30 minutes from Caticlan Airport. The 312-room resort features a 3,300sqm multi-level pool -- the largest in Boracay -- across eight room types, multiple restaurants and bars, a private beach, and the Sagay Spa. Guests consistently praise the beachfront location, cleanliness, and attentive service, though a subset note noise issues, dated decor in places, and some overpriced offerings.

faqs.question: Where is Movenpick Resort & Spa Boracay located?
faqs.answer: On Punta Bunga Cove, on the northern tip of Boracay Island in Barangay Yapak, about 30 minutes from Caticlan Airport.

faqs.question: Does Movenpick Resort & Spa Boracay have a large pool?
faqs.answer: Yes -- its 3,300sqm multi-level pool is the largest in Boracay, complemented by a private beach and the on-site Sagay Spa.
